_README: HORRIBLE IDEAS. Real quotes from the owner, free to reuse with his name on
them. Adding one means appending one object to the array below, then
running scripts/build-quote-qr.py when the line carries a new url.
text   the line as it reads on the page and on the front of the shirt.
back   optional. The second beat; prints on the back of the shirt.
src    optional. A short label naming where the line came from.
url    optional. The video or clip the line came from. The card's QR
points here, and falls back to the page itself without one.
The one rule: every line traces to words the owner said, wrote or
published. Wording may tighten; the thought may not change hands. Nothing
here gets generated to fill the list out.
emptyState renders in place of the list when the array runs empty.

jokes.text: Philosophy is just survivorship bias for the unenlightened.
I am NOT that I am NOT.

jokes.text: Nobody has ever bruised a shin on an identity.
Plato forgot to mention the cave is where all your friends live.
I don't believe in God.
Every birthday party is secretly an advance planning meeting for your funeral.
Procrastination is just a prayer strategy designed to force a miracle.
Nobody remembers Daedalus because he actually knew how to fly.
God fulfills every prayer instantly by doing absolutely nothing at all.
Most people choose the blue pill while lecturing about the red.
A 401k just funds your future inability to stay busy.
Socrates got poisoned just for asking people to define their jobs.
“God” is a three-letter word.
Two minutes is plenty of time to solve original sin.
Silicon Valley spent billions to reinvent the concept of a library.
Aristotle mocked the sophists. Tech giants now charge trillions for them.
Worship not false idols.
Anesthesia is a terrible long-term substitute for actually being awake.
Commenters rarely look up a definition before declaring war.
A couch that urges you to stay seated is spiritually dangerous.
We are all dogs in God's car.
Social media turned the toolmaker into the product.
Never criticize the snake when it was placed there on purpose.
Trust no god.
People prefer a resurrected corpse over simply following the instructions.
You can perform public miracles and people will mostly just panic.
Bragging about good luck simply gives the universe a target to hit.
Treating the Almighty like a drive-thru window saves everyone forty minutes.
Getting exactly what you wished for is usually a terrible surprise.
An empty head beats useless thoughts.
Autumn is called fall because December trips over the edge of winter.
Videodrome was a documentary.
